name: Get Smart List by ID
summary: Fetches one smart list's details — optionally including its rules (triggers and filters).
whenToUse: When you have a smart list ID and want to see what it contains.

path.name: id
path.label: Smart List ID
path.hint: Find it via List Smart Lists.

query.name: includeRules
query.label: Include rules
query.hint: Adds the list's triggers and filters to the response.

response.description: The smart list record (with rules when requested).

notes: In the Marketo UI the 'in' operator for Member of List appears as 'is' in the API response.
